text: The partition coefficient, K , shows the distribution of a solute between two immiscible solvents.
K is determined by measuring the concentration of the solute in each solvent.
The organic solvent ethoxyethane, CH CH OCH CH , and water are immiscible. A student is
asked to find K of butanedioic acid, HOOCCH CH COOH, between ethoxyethane and water.
The expression for K when butanedioic acid is in equilibrium between ethoxyethane and water is
[density: ethoxyethane, 0.71 g cm ; water, 1.00 g cm ]
The student uses the following method to find the partition coefficient. A diagram of the apparatus
step 1 Add 30.0 cm of distilled water to a separating funnel.
step 2 Weigh by difference 2.81 g of butanedioic acid into the separating funnel.
step 3 Stopper the separating funnel and shake it until the butanedioic acid has dissolved.
step 4 Remove the stopper and add 30.0 cm of ethoxyethane to the separating funnel.
step 5 Replace the stopper and shake the separating funnel gently.
step 6 Place the separating funnel into a clamp. Allow the liquids to settle so that the two layers
step 7 Remove the stopper and open the separating funnel tap to allow the lower layer to run
into a beaker labelled A. Run the upper layer into a beaker labelled B.
